## Changelog

### New features

- You can now use custom loaders, using EML AdminTool, or by setting the `profile.minecraft.loader.manifestUrl` (or `minecraft.loader.manifestUrl`) property your launch configuration. This allows you to use a custom version manifest for the selected loader.

### Changes

- Refactor the launch process to download every file in a single pass, instead of downloading the Vanilla and modded files first, and then downloading the loader files.

### Bug fixes and improvements

- Updated dependencies to the latest versions.
